title: Subarrays with XOR at Least K
summary: Given an array of positive integers of length n and a non-negative integer k, return the count of contiguous subarrays where the bitwise XOR of all elements is at least k.
statement: Given an array of positive integers of length n and a non-negative integer k, return the count of contiguous subarrays where the bitwise XOR of all elements is at least k.
constraints: Up to 100,000 nonnegative values and threshold k.
Count contiguous subarrays whose XOR is at least k.
Return the exact count, which may exceed 32-bit range.
hints: A subarray XOR is the XOR of two prefix values.
Store earlier prefixes in a binary trie and count partners producing XOR below k.
For each new prefix, add count_less(prefix,k), insert it, then subtract the total below-k pairs from all subarrays.
The trie follows equal or differing bits according to k, counting every earlier prefix exactly once.
editorial: The trie follows equal or differing bits according to k, counting every earlier prefix exactly once.

tests.explanation: Six subarrays have XOR at least two.
All six subarrays qualify when k is zero.
